name: hero-copy
text:
From pixels to clinically credible biomarkers.
BD-MedVis brings together computer vision, medical imaging and clinical AI to create image-derived biomarkers that are biologically grounded, reproducible and clinically meaningful. Join researchers across radiology, pathology and multimodal medicine to advance trustworthy methods for precision care.
